<a id="colour_side_blocks"></a>
### [`colour_side_blocks`](../../../../src/screen/colours.asm#L6) `$9204`

*routine*

Sets the colours of rows 2-5. Columns 0-3 get screen $73 and colour RAM $0e. Columns 36-39 get $7d and $05.

- **Called from:** [`start`](../init/init.md#start)
- **Writes:** [`$D850`](../../../../src/graphics/arena2_bitmap.asm#L244), [`$D878`](../../../../src/graphics/arena2_bitmap.asm#L248), [`$D8A0`](../../../../src/graphics/arena2_bitmap.asm#L253), [`$D8C8`](../../../../src/graphics/arena2_bitmap.asm#L256), [`$D874`](../../../../src/graphics/arena2_bitmap.asm#L247), [`$D89C`](../../../../src/graphics/arena2_bitmap.asm#L253), [`$D8C4`](../../../../src/graphics/arena2_bitmap.asm#L256), [`$D8EC`](../../../../src/graphics/arena2_bitmap.asm#L261), [`screen_corner_left_row2`](screen_ram.md#screen_corner_left_row2), [`screen_corner_left_row3`](screen_ram.md#screen_corner_left_row3), [`screen_corner_left_row4`](screen_ram.md#screen_corner_left_row4), [`screen_corner_left_row5`](screen_ram.md#screen_corner_left_row5) and 4 more

<a id="reset_fight_colours"></a>
### [`reset_fight_colours`](../../../../src/screen/colours.asm#L33) `$9242`

*routine*

Sets the colours of the fight area, rows 14-21, columns 4-35: screen RAM $c0 and colour RAM $0a. Removes the colours of a text there.

- **Called from:** [`start`](../init/init.md#start), [`change_scene`](scene.md#change_scene), [`read_keys`](../input/keyboard.md#read_keys), [`quit_to_demo`](../main/quit_to_demo.md#quit_to_demo)
